items.title: Live Updates: Hundreds Missing as Deadly Floods Sweep Away Villages in Nepal
items.summary: A wall of water crashed through a Himalayan river valley between Nepal and the Chinese territory of Tibet, killing dozens of people, the Nepali authorities said. The missing included border officials, port workers and foreign tourists.
